title: My educational RPG turns "learn vocabulary" into "listen to the world". Here's what playtesting changed
author: Expensive-Soil-1159
selftext:
Itch.io Link: [https://justinventroni.itch.io/mandarilearn](https://justinventroni.itch.io/mandarilearn)

I'm making MandariLearn, a pixel RPG that teaches Mandarin. Instead of flashcards, every word lives on the thing it names: walk up to a tree, hold a key, and a ring fills while you listen, then you pick the pinyin you heard.

My first playtester couldn't follow the opening, and the fix was to stop telling and start showing:

* A trail of arrows on the ground instead of hint text
* Key prompts drawn over the character's head (WASD, E, "hold E" with a filling bar)
* Doors got doormats; sounds you can hear got a speaker icon
* The opening only lets you walk the screens the trail crosses, then the world opens up

Would love feedback on the opening and the listening loop.
